name: @kufayeka/node-red-tsdb-engine
description: Historian core for Node-RED: ts, tag, value (number, bool, string) with Gorilla compression and a summary pyramid (chunk, hour, day); fast aggregates over any range: delta, counter increase, integral (kW to kWh), states, on the edge, no database server.

scripts.test: node test/gorilla.test.js && node test/engine.test.js && node test/worker.test.js && node test/admin.test.js && node test/integrity.test.js && node test/robust.test.js && node test/chunking.test.js && node test/compact.test.js && node test/rollup.test.js && node test/fuzz.test.js --rounds 20 && node test/restart.test.js && node test/nodes.test.js && node test/fault.test.js --rounds 6 && node test/fault.test.js --rounds 4 --soft 1

author: kufayeka
